root_idea.summary: The supplied lexical evidence centers on directing oneself toward a side, place, or goal, while also preserving a distinct branch of diminution after increase.
root_idea.development: Spatial orientation is extended to deliberate pursuit of an object and to seeking what is most suitable; related lexical branches express aptitude, probability, and comparative suitability. A separate branch describes something waning after growth, with a specialized use for an aged, wasted viper.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized perfect citation form تَحَرَّى rather than the inflected QAC surface form.

senses.definition: To seek, aim at, pursue, or endeavor to attain a goal or object.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the object is right guidance or a right course; the construction expresses deliberate pursuit of that goal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To decrease, diminish, or wane after having increased.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thing that diminishes or wanes, such as the moon.
Used in the construction حَرَى أَنْ يَكُونَ ذٰلِكَ, meaning that something may or might be so.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be adapted, suited, fit, competent, or worthy for something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Constructed with بِ and the relevant object or matter; the sense concerns suitability or deservingness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause something to decrease, diminish, or wane.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject is stated to be time, which causes a thing to diminish.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most suitable, apt, proper, or worthy; how suitable or worthy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used comparatively, as in أَحْرَى بِذٰلِكَ, and in exclamatory constructions such as مَا أَحْرَاهُ and أَحْرِ بِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The vicinity, quarter, tract, region, or environs of a person, people, or house.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may denote the surrounding area or local quarter; its plural is reported as أَحْرَاءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Adapted, apt, suitable, proper, or worthy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used predicatively with بِ or with an أن-clause to state that a person, thing, or matter is suited or worthy to do or receive something.
Predicated of a person or thing to indicate that an event is likely to happen, or has probably happened or been so.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Aged and wasted in body; specifically, an epithet applied to a viper in this condition and regarded as especially malignant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The specialized epithet describes a viper whose body has diminished through age, leaving it particularly noxious.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or repair to the vicinity, quarter, tract, or region of a people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This spatial construction takes a place or a people's vicinity as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek what is most suitable, proper, or deserving among alternatives.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of deliberating in an affair, especially choosing between two things according to the judgment that seems strongest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tarry, wait, or pause in expectation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction is reported with بِالمكان, ‘at the place.’
